abort.no_xiaomi_home: Set up the Xiaomi Home integration first.
abort.no_vacuums: Xiaomi Home has no vacuum devices.
abort.already_configured: This vacuum already has a map.

init.title: Mi account for the map
init.description:
Xiaomi Home's own login can't download the map, so this integration signs in to your Mi account (the legacy API) only to get the map file link. Everything else still goes through Xiaomi Home. The password and the session are stored in this config entry.

{info}

captcha.title: Captcha
captcha.description:
Xiaomi wants a captcha for this sign-in. Type the characters you see:

{image}

twofa.title: Verification code
twofa.description: Xiaomi sent a verification code by {channel}. Enter it here.

error.wrong_code: That code was wrong. Try again.
error.invalid_auth: Xiaomi refused the login, see the message above.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Xiaomi. Check Home Assistant's internet connection and try again.
